extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: FOMO60K is a large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources. The dataset includes both clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences (T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, T1ce, PD, SWI, GRE, and others), and a wide range of anatomical and pathological variability, including scans with large brain anomalies. Minimal preprocessing was applied to preserve the original image characteristics while reducing barriers to entry for new users. Accompanying code for self-supervised pretraining and finetuning is provided.
extraction.creator: Asbjørn Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora García, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Mads Nielsen
extraction.publisher: University of Copenhagen, Pioneer Centre For AI
extraction.citeAs: Munk, A., Cerri, S., et al. A large-scale heterogeneous 3D magnetic resonance brain imaging dataset for self-supervised learning. arXiv:2506.14432v1 [eess.IV] (2025).
extraction.rai:dataCollection: FOMO60K is derived from 16 publicly available datasets aggregated to form a large-scale, heterogeneous brain MRI dataset. The dataset spans both clinical- and research-grade imaging, includes multiple MRI sequences, and captures anatomical and pathological diversity including scans with large brain anomalies.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: In some datasets, scan sequence metadata was not available or could not be reliably identified (listed as 'Unknown' for MGH Wild10). In cases where sequence information is unavailable, scans are generically named scan_X.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Brain MRI scans aggregated from 16 publicly available sources: MGH Wild10, SOOP, BraTS-GEN, OASIS1, OASIS2, MSD Braintumor, IXI, NIMH, DLBS, IDEAS, ARC, MBSR, UCLA, QTAB, NKI, and AOMIC ID1000.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) scans stored in 4D format, if a b=0 (non-diffusion-weighted) volume was available, it was extracted and saved separately. For the b=1000 shell, three diffusion-weighted volumes were selected based on their gradient directions being most closely aligned with the canonical x, y, and z axes (determined by cosine similarity between each gradient vector and orthogonal unit vectors), and the corresponding volumes were averaged to produce a single representative 3D image. Subjects have been shuffled to protect privacy and prevent easy identification of dataset sources.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: (1) reorienting images to RAS (Right–Anterior–Superior) orientation using mri_coreg from FreeSurfer 7.4.1 with default parameters; (2) affine co-registration, with scans within each MRI session aligned to the image with the highest spatial resolution; (3) skull-stripping using SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1), which outputs segmentation masks of brain structures used to define the brain extraction region. Skull-stripping was only applied when images were not already defaced or skull-stripped by the dataset provider, or when visual inspection identified residual cranial features that could compromise anonymization. All MRI scans are stored in NIfTI-compressed format.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1) for skull-stripping and brain segmentation; FreeSurfer 7.4.1 mri_coreg for affine co-registration and reorientation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available. It was developed in parallel with the FOMO25 challenge at MICCAI 2025.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Brain MRI scans from human subjects. Skull-stripping or defacing was applied to all scans to protect anonymization. Subjects have been shuffled to prevent easy identification of dataset sources.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: FOMO60K is intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale, lowering barriers to entry for neuroimaging research and facilitating broader adoption of SSL in medical imaging.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Existing neuroimaging resources are often curated for specific diseases or patient populations and typically follow homogeneous imaging protocols with limited pathological variability. FOMO60K attempts to address this by aggregating heterogeneous sources, but the dataset is still limited to the 16 publicly available sources included.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is aggregated from 16 publicly available sources and may not fully represent real-world population-level diversity. Some datasets have unknown sequence metadata. The dataset is currently limited to brain MRI and does not include other modalities or body regions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for self-supervised pretraining and finetuning of machine learning models for medical imaging. It can be used with no further preprocessing for pre-training. It also supports benchmarking and method development for SSL in medical imaging. Users are asked to cite the source datasets: OASIS1, OASIS2, BraTS2024, MSD Braintumor, IXI, MGH Wild10, NKI.
